get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of products belonging to one session, with optional search.

post.description: Create a new product with the provided details.

patch.description: Update the details of an existing product.

delete.description: Delete an existing product by its ID.

post.summary: Create a new stock opname session
post.description: Create a new stock opname session with the provided details.

get.description: Retrieve a list of all stock opname sessions.

get.summary: Get a specific stock opname session
get.description: Retrieve details of a specific stock opname session by its ID.

patch.description: Update session status. Rejected with 409 for COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions and for IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED when the session has no products.

delete.description: Hard delete. COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions are always deletable; IN_PROGRESS only when it has no products and no stock opname results. All child rows (products, barcodes, results, racks, coordinators) are removed by cascade.

get.summary: Generate a stock opname session PDF report
get.description: Generate an inline PDF report containing session details, coordinators, and stock opname results.

get.summary: Generate a stock opname session Excel report
get.description: Generate a downloadable Excel report containing stock opname results with product prices, rack, coordinator, session code, and update timestamp.

get.summary: Generate a stock opname session DBF report
get.description: Generate a downloadable dBASE III compatible DBF report containing stock opname results with product prices, rack, coordinator, session code, and update timestamp.

get.summary: Get coordinators for a stock opname session

get.description: Generate an inline PDF report containing coordinator details and stock opname results.

get.summary: Generate a coordinator upload summary PDF
get.description: Generate an inline PDF with one row per upload: coordinator code, upload number, total quantity, total buy value, and total sell value.

get.summary: Get a specific coordinator for a stock opname session
get.description: Retrieve details of a specific coordinator by its ID, including parent session code and location for scan-QR join preview.

patch.summary: Update a coordinator for a stock opname session
patch.description: Update the details of an existing coordinator.

get.summary: Get all racks for a session or coordinator
get.description: Retrieve all racks. Use this list to delete unused racks.

get.summary: Get progress of racks for a specific session or coordinator
get.description: Retrieve the progress of racks for a specific stock opname session or coordinator.

get.summary: Get all stock opname result items for a specific session, coordinator, or rack

post.description: Upsert products + barcodes from a PRODUK.DBF ("produk") and BARCODE.DBF ("barcode") multipart pair. Idempotent. Use ?dry_run=true to validate without writing.
Removes all products and barcodes of one session. Requires ?sessionId=&confirm=true. Stock opname history is untouched.

delete.description: Rejected with 409 when the session is final, the rack was already uploaded, the rack has items, or it is the last rack of the coordinator.

post.summary: Join a coordinator by scanning its QR code
post.description: Validates the coordinator and returns its racks. Each rack carries uploaded_at so a second device can skip finished racks.

get.summary: Get upload history for a coordinator

post.summary: Submit a batch of racks as one upload
post.description: Creates one upload row grouping every rack in the batch. A rack can only belong to one upload; when any rack was already uploaded the whole batch is rejected with 409.

get.summary: Download the upload PDF for a rack
get.description: Rendered from the immutable snapshots of every rack in the upload, grouped per rack.

barcodes.description: Replaces the whole barcode set when present.

barcode.description: Scanned barcode. Either barcode or plu is required.

plu.description: Product PLU. Either barcode or plu is required.

upload_number.description: Urutan upload per koordinator. 1 = upload pertama.
